artifact.scope: Superseded private v2 test build; later rebuilds require separate validation.

provenance.assembly_scope: Existing collected backend received the framework repair; no fresh full PyInstaller rebuild at the fix revision. Electron then assembled and ad-hoc signed the app.
provenance.verification_checkout_scope: Checkout at verification; installed binaries are bound by the recorded file hashes, without inferring a binary build commit
provenance.binary_identity: Artifact and installed-file hashes bind this proof; the current checkout is not asserted to be the binary build revision.

packaging.distribution_scope: Local private test; public binary held pending coordinator source and notice completion.

collected_backend_audit.scope: Collected backend after framework repair, before Electron packaging; not a fresh audit of every final app binary.

electron_artifact_relationship.scope: Signing can change executable bytes; collected payload audit and installed artifact hashes describe separate stages.

installation.method: Actual Finder copy from mounted DMG through its Applications alias
installation.preservation_scope: The installed native proof rehashed its 15 recorded app/backend/source files; the Python framework copy hash is from the installation receipt.

packaged_app_lifecycle.scope: Packaged build-output app launch and quit before the later Finder-installed 8K test.

installed_native_8k_gui_export.scope: Finder-installed native GUI; generated native 8K RGB16 video and PCM audio; Modern lens plus title; independent decode after workers exited.
installed_native_8k_gui_export.timestamp_tolerance: Half container time-base tick plus one microsecond; Matroska PTS are quantized
installed_native_8k_gui_export.timing_scope: API job creation to publication file mtime; includes queue/startup/verification

installed_test_resources.scope: Sum of sampled installed main-app and descendant process RSS; device memory is outside RSS

limitations: The installed GUI export contains two frames; separate 24-frame native and PNG16 sequence proofs have different scopes.
Sampled process-tree RSS is host residency, can include shared mappings, and is not GPU allocator/Metal driver memory or a guaranteed instantaneous peak.
Static auditing covers Mach-O linked load commands and run paths, not arbitrary dlopen/plugins or every runtime resource; Apple system libraries/frameworks remain external.
The 300-file audit covers the collected payload before Electron signing; it is not a full final-app Mach-O re-audit.
Local ad-hoc launch/install/signature checks establish neither Developer ID signing, notarization nor Gatekeeper acceptance for a downloaded quarantined artifact.
Synthetic source color tags were partly unspecified; project BT.709 assumptions were applied. This does not establish HDR color-management correctness.
Matroska PTS are quantized to the container time base; cadence was checked using the recorded tolerance, not exact i/24 PTS.
